clues.label: A biographical detail
clues.text: The composer wrote more than six hundred songs for voice and piano, yet heard almost none of his orchestral music performed in public during his lifetime.

clues.label: Places the composer lived and worked
clues.text: The composer spent nearly the whole of a short life in and around one imperial capital, frequently without a piano of his own, lodging with friends.

clues.label: A relationship with contemporaries
clues.text: The composer's circle of friends held regular evening gatherings devoted entirely to his music. The name coined for those evenings is still in use today.

clues.label: A musical characteristic
clues.text: The cycle sets twenty-four poems by Wilhelm Müller, following a rejected traveller out into a winter landscape.

explanation.summary: The song output, the circle of friends, and the Müller settings identify Franz Schubert, writing in Vienna in 1827.

points.text: Six hundred-odd lieder set against almost no public orchestral performance describes Schubert's position precisely.
The capital is Vienna, where Schubert lived almost his entire life and where this cycle was written the year before his death.
Twenty-four Müller settings on a winter journey identifies Winterreise, D. 911.
